problem:
Given that the minor of ${a}_{11}$ is $0$, find all the possible values of $p$ in the matrix

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}5 & 2 & 3 \\ 1 & p & 7 \\ 6 & -8 & p-15\end{aligned}].
$$

In **ascending order**, the values of $p$ are

$p=$ 
{{field-1}} $\,$ and $\,p=$
{{field-2}}.
worked_solution:
To evaluate the minor of ${a}_{11},$ we remove the first row and first column:

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}5 & ∗ & ∗ \\ ∗ & p & 7 \\ ∗ & -8 & p-15\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor of ${a}_{11}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{det}[\begin{aligned}p & 7 \\ -8 & p-15\end{aligned}] & =|\begin{aligned}p & 7 \\ -8 & p-15\end{aligned}| \\  & =p(p-15)-7(-8) \\  & ={p}^{2}-15p+56.\end{aligned}
$$

We're told that the minor of ${a}_{11}$ is $0$, so we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{p}^{2}-15p+56 & =0 \\ (p-7)(p-8) & =0.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, in ascending order, the solutions are $p=7$ and $p=8.$
